## Reynolds Consumer Products Declares Regular Quarterly Cash Dividend


July 23, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.reynoldsconsumerproducts.com/node/10476/pdf)


LAKE FOREST, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jul. 23, 2026-- Reynolds Consumer Products Inc. (Nasdaq: REYN) announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.23 per common share. The dividend is payable on August 31, 2026, to shareholders of record as of August 17, 2026.


**About Reynolds Consumer Products Inc.**


Reynolds Consumer Products is a leading provider of household essentials designed to simplify daily life, so consumers can enjoy what matters most. Found in 95% of U.S. homes, the Company offers trusted solutions for cooking, cleanup, food storage, and more. Its portfolio features iconic brands like Reynolds Wrap® aluminum foil and Hefty® trash bags and disposable tableware, along with store brand products tailored to retail partners. Reynolds holds the No. 1 or No. 2 U.S. market share in most of the categories it serves. Learn more at:[investors.reynoldsconsumerproducts.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.reynoldsconsumerproducts.com%2F&esheet=54575962&newsitemid=20260723624075&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.reynoldsconsumerproducts.com&index=1&md5=7a0f07f0406492ca7458d0eb457e9b8f)
